target.title: fix(exec): require approval for OpenClaw lifecycle commands
target.body:
﻿Fixes #99518

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where exec commands through gateway or node hosts could let OpenClaw gateway/daemon lifecycle mutations pass through normal allowlist or auto-review paths when they should require explicit approval.

The affected workflow is OpenClaw self-management from exec surfaces: stopping, starting, restarting, running, deleting, or uninstalling the gateway/daemon through CLI, launchctl, systemctl, schtasks, process-kill, shell-wrapper, package-manager, Windows shim, `env -S`, `xargs`/`find`, `sudo`/`doas`, and dispatch-wrapper commands.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a focused lifecycle classifier to the exec approval policy and wires it into the main gateway-host, node-host, and direct `system.run` approval paths. The guard forces explicit approval for OpenClaw lifecycle mutations unless exec is already in yolo mode (`security=full`, `ask=off`).

Foreground gateway runtime forms such as `openclaw gateway`, `openclaw gateway run`, `openclaw gateway restart`, and `openclaw gateway --force restart` are treated as lifecycle mutations. Read-only inspection remains outside the guard, including `openclaw gateway status`, `openclaw gateway --help`, `openclaw gateway run --help`, `launchctl print`, `systemctl status`, `schtasks /Query`, and generic read-only process lookups. `openclaw gateway call` is method-aware: lifecycle RPCs such as `update.run` and `gateway.restart.request` require explicit lifecycle approval, while read-only RPCs such as `health`, `update.status`, and `logs.tail` do not.

The classifier also handles lifecycle commands hidden behind common command carriers, including nested `env`, `env -S`, shell wrappers, package runners, `find`/`xargs`, process-kill pipelines, known environment expansions, unknown partial environments that could expand to OpenClaw, and Node launcher forms without treating benign `node -e` / `node --print` script arguments as executable paths. The classifier remains out of `openclaw/plugin-sdk/infra-runtime`; the deprecated SDK shim now explicitly preserves the previous exec approval exports without exposing this internal lifecycle taxonomy as plugin API.

## User Impact

Operators get an extra human confirmation before an agent or auto-review path can stop, start, restart, run, delete, or uninstall the OpenClaw gateway/daemon in non-yolo configurations. Existing yolo-mode behavior, read-only status/query commands, and public plugin SDK export counts are unchanged.

## Evidence

Final branch head validated: `c1d8b304fd6cfb148b58c87e5da13740341117ae`.

Before/source proof: current `main` only hard-gated the existing security-audit suppression case before generic ask/allowlist/auto-review handling. OpenClaw lifecycle mutations were not classified before durable allowlist or auto-review decisions in the gateway-host, node-host, or direct `system.run` paths.

After-fix direct classifier proof on this head, importing the production `commandRequiresOpenClawLifecycleApproval` function and parsing each command through the same shell-argv splitter used by the policy:

```json
{
  "branchHead": "c1d8b304fd",
  "results": [
    { "label": "gateway force restart", "command": "openclaw gateway --force restart", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "gateway run port", "command": "openclaw gateway run --port 18889", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "gateway lifecycle rpc", "command": "openclaw gateway call update.run --params '{}'", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "gateway readonly rpc", "command": "openclaw gateway call update.status", "requiresLifecycleApproval": false },
    { "label": "deep env lifecycle", "command": "env env env env env openclaw gateway restart", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "env-S lifecycle", "command": "env -S 'openclaw gateway --force restart'", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "shell env lifecycle", "command": "env CMD=openclaw sh -c '$CMD gateway restart'", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "package runner lifecycle", "command": "npx openclaw@latest -- gateway restart", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "process kill pipeline", "command": "pidof openclaw | xargs kill", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true },
    { "label": "node eval argv", "command": "node -e 'console.log(process.argv)' openclaw gateway restart", "requiresLifecycleApproval": false },
    { "label": "readonly status", "command": "openclaw status --all", "requiresLifecycleApproval": false },
    { "label": "systemctl status", "command": "systemctl --type service status openclaw-gateway.service", "requiresLifecycleApproval": false },
    { "label": "systemctl lifecycle signal", "command": "systemctl --signal=TERM kill openclaw-gateway.service", "requiresLifecycleApproval": true }
  ]
}
```

Earlier isolated gateway-host proof exercised the runtime approval path with `openclaw gateway --force`: an isolated branch gateway was healthy, the lifecycle command returned a blocking `approval-unavailable` result before execution, `autoReviewCalls` stayed `0`, and yolo mode (`security=full`, `ask=off`) still passed through without the lifecycle warning. Later follow-ups expanded classifier coverage; the final head revalidated the host/runtime approval surfaces with the focused tests below.

Focused tests on final head:

```shell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle|env -S|SHELL|xargs|find|openclaw update|--update|uninstall|openclaw@|pnpm dlx openclaw --|OC_BIN|update.run|update.status|dry-run|partial environments|complete|read-only or generic|eval|deeply nested transparent carriers|gateway --force restart|gateway --port 18789 restart|pidof openclaw|pgrep -f openclaw|unknown POSIX plus|carries env assignments|node -e|node --print|node -r"
# Tests  261 passed | 85 skipped (346)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle|gateway lifecycle RPC|durable allowlist"
# Tests  5 passed | 53 skipped (58)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Tests  1 passed | 48 skipped (49)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/node-host/invoke-system-run.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle|empty env operands"
# Tests  2 passed | 33 skipped (35)
```

SDK surface report on final head:

```shell
node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check
# passed
# public package SDK entrypoints: exports 10421, callable exports 5233
# infra-runtime budget restored to 585; the lifecycle classifier is not public plugin SDK surface
# public wildcard reexports: 213
```

Static/type checks on final head:

```shell
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
# passed

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo
# passed

$files = git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD; node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs @files
# passed

git diff --check
# passed
```

Autoreview note: branch autoreview was clean on the previous `e43e1f19b6` head before the SDK shim repair. After the SDK shim repair on this final head, the local autoreview helper was attempted again but was blocked by a Codex usage-limit error before returning review findings, so this PR does not claim a clean local autoreview result for `c1d8b304fd`. The latest ClawSweeper re-review is the authoritative reviewer for this final head.

Proof limitation: the final proof covers the main gateway-host, node-host, and direct `system.run` exec approval paths touched by this PR. It does not claim to redesign unrelated plugin SDK/app-server auto-review surfaces.
